svg.title: SLAP2 glutamate signal quality, candidate A: median event amplitude
svg.desc: A shows one raw trace with detected events and an amplitude measurement; B its footprint; C and D the DMD1 and DMD2 dendritic maps of the example session, with scale bars. Sources are colored by median event amplitude in raw-noise SD. E shows the event amplitudes of the sources at the 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles of that session, with a spectrum-matched noise-only curve; F the distribution across 2,521 sources in two processing cohorts; G the per-pool and per-session distributions.
